core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mahfouz corresponds to the Arabic form محفوظ (Arabic root ح ف ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ); مَحْفُوظ (Maḥfūẓ)). Its core sense is protected, safeguarded, preserved. Mahfouz is Arabic مَحْفُوظ (Maḥfūẓ) 'protected, safeguarded, preserved', from the root ح ف ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ); it is a well-documented male given name borne by the novelist Naguib Mahfouz. The source gloss 'Preserved, Safekeeping' is broadly consistent. Same name as mahfoud, mahfuj and mahfuz.
